div.div: Reading guide One k3s node runs ns campaign (finder, apply-worker, campaign-api, kafka-0, mongo-0, msrouter) and ns default (lubuntu-agent). Images are built on the host with docker and imported with k3s ctr images import; there is no registry. msrouter is pinned to 0 replicas and finder runs with FINDER_SCORING_ENABLED=false while the pipeline is paused. apply-worker reaches Chrome over CDP at the node IP port 30922 (NodePort 9222:30922). Host data lives under /home/mstro/k3s-pod-data, owned by mstro. The laptop host sshd does not auto-start after a reboot.
